acceptance_criteria: Old jobs are disabled only after the new job passes monitoring checks
Rollback procedure is documented and exercised once
No gap or duplication in processed records across the cutover
item.description: The existing jobs run on the legacy scheduler and are removed only after the replacement runs cleanly for a week. The new pipeline reads the same source tables and produces byte-compatible output files. The migration runs as a series of small cutovers to keep rollback cheap. Historical data is replayed into the new system before the switch.
